# Rotaract Club of Lalitpur

> Rotaract Club of Lalitpur (RAC Lalitpur) is a youth-led community service club in Lalitpur, Nepal. Chartered on December 28, 1998, it is part of Rotary International District 3292. Its motto is "Perceive & Excel." The club brings young adults together for community service, leadership, fellowship, and cultural preservation.

## Key facts

- Chartered: December 28, 1998
- District: Rotary International District 3292
- Membership: Ages 18 and above
- Membership fee: NPR 500 one-time
- Meetings: Every alternate Saturday, T&B Restaurant, Balkumari, Lalitpur
- Email: lalitpur@rotaract3292.org
- Phone: +977-9818706474

## Pages

- [Home](https://rotaractcluboflalitpur.org.np/): Club overview, community impact, and featured initiatives.
- [About](https://rotaractcluboflalitpur.org.np/about/): Club history, mission, leadership, and past presidents.
- [Projects](https://rotaractcluboflalitpur.org.np/projects/): All community service projects.
- [Candle Walk 1146](https://rotaractcluboflalitpur.org.np/projects/candle-walk/): Annual Nepal Sambat cultural celebration in Lalitpur.
- [Nyano Maya](https://rotaractcluboflalitpur.org.np/projects/nyano-maya/): Health awareness and community support at Future Hope Nepal Children's Home.
- [Matya Health Camp](https://rotaractcluboflalitpur.org.np/projects/matya-health-camp/): Community health support during Lalitpur's Matya festival.
- [Lumanti Magazine Vol. 18](https://rotaractcluboflalitpur.org.np/projects/lumanti-magazine/): Annual club publication and launch.
- [Gallery](https://rotaractcluboflalitpur.org.np/gallery/): Photos from club events and projects.
- [Join](https://rotaractcluboflalitpur.org.np/join/): Membership eligibility, fee, meetings, and joining steps.
- [Contact](https://rotaractcluboflalitpur.org.np/contact/): Contact details and inquiry form.
